justification: 97 Gold and 284 Silver records (381 total supervised training pool) have verified physical source artifacts, cryptographic SHA-256 hashes, exact text evidence spans, and decoupled consequences. However, 2,411 Bronze records originate from catalog metadata without local PDF/HTML files and are isolated in quarantine. Furthermore, the corpus exhibits extreme positive class skew (SIF TRUE=695, FALSE=14, UNKNOWN=2,261; supervised pool TRUE=380, FALSE=1) reflecting external regulatory reporting bias. This corpus does not currently provide a sufficiently representative binary SIF-positive/SIF-negative supervised dataset, but is validated for high-energy characterization, IOGP Life-Saving Rule tagging, and semantic retrieval.

ua_uc_representation.finding: External regulatory bodies publish almost exclusively serious incidents (1,419) and high-potential near misses (1,514). Proactive Unsafe Act / Unsafe Condition observations must be ingested from internal operational observation cards.
